components.name: Primary action
components.description: Blue action with the currently inherited hover; hover drift is not a palette token.
components.css: .ds-primary{border:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;font-family:ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;background:var(--blue,#256b86);color:#fff;border:1px solid #00000008;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 11px;font-weight:500;justify-content:center;min-height:32px;}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#1c73c8;}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#256b86);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){background:var(--selected,#e7eae5);filter:brightness(.9);}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;}:host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-primary{color:#182329;}:host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--blue,#8ec5db);}

components.name: Subtle action
components.description: Muted secondary action without a resting fill.

components.name: Native text field
components.description: Thin-bordered native field with shared focus.
components.css: .ds-input{font-family:ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;background:transparent;color:var(--text,#292b2c);border:1px solid var(--line,#e3e5e0);border-radius:4px;padding:8px;max-width:100%;caret-color:var(--blue,#256b86);}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--faint,#6d706b);}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#256b86);outline-offset:2px;}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-input{font-size:16px;}}

components.name: Sidebar navigation
components.description: A single filled current location and neutral New page action.
components.css: .ds-nav{background:var(--sidebar,#f6f6f4);width:216px;padding:0 12px 20px;}.ds-nav button{border:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;font-family:ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;width:100%;height:36px;margin-bottom:3px;gap:10px;padding:0 8px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--muted,#626661);background:transparent;font-weight:500;}.ds-nav button.ds-nav-current{background:var(--selected,#e7eae5);color:var(--text,#292b2c);}.ds-nav button.ds-nav-create{color:var(--text,#292b2c);margin-top:12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#e3e5e0);background:var(--panel,#fff);}.ds-nav button:hover{background:var(--hover,#f0f1ee);}.ds-nav button:active{background:var(--selected,#e7eae5);}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#256b86);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-nav svg{color:var(--muted,#626661);}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-nav button{min-height:44px;}}.ds-nav button.ds-nav-current:hover{background:var(--selected,#e7eae5);}

components.name: Blue category tag
components.description: Content category with theme-specific readable colors.

components.name: Database record card
components.description: Flat record card with wrapping title and category metadata.
components.css: .ds-card{font-family:ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;display:block;width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line,#e3e5e0);background:var(--panel,#fff);color:var(--text,#292b2c);border-radius:8px;padding:14px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:none;margin-bottom:8px;}.ds-card-name{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;margin-bottom:8px;}.ds-card-name strong{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-weight:550;line-height:1.5;}.ds-card svg{flex-shrink:0;color:var(--muted,#626661);}.ds-card-meta{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#626661);display:block;}.ds-card:hover{background:var(--hover,#f0f1ee);}.ds-card:active{background:var(--selected,#e7eae5);}.ds-card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#256b86);outline-offset:2px;}

components.css: .ds-views{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;flex-wrap:wrap;}.ds-views button{border:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;line-height:1.4;cursor:pointer;font-family:ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;padding:8px 9px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--muted,#626661);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;background:transparent;white-space:nowrap;}.ds-views button.ds-view-current{color:var(--text,#292b2c);background:var(--hover,#f0f1ee);font-weight:600;}.ds-views button.ds-more{gap:3px;padding:8px 6px;font-size:12px;}.ds-views button:hover{background:var(--hover,#f0f1ee);}.ds-views button:active{background:var(--selected,#e7eae5);}.ds-views button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#256b86);outline-offset:2px;}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-views button{font-size:12px;padding:8px 6px;}}

narrative.overview:
Jotstead is a flat, neutral working surface: calm enough for long writing sessions, compact enough for real databases. White and softly neutral light surfaces become charcoal in dark mode; a restrained blue identifies action, focus and editable state. The interface uses the platform system sans family, while documents retain their own serif, mono, size and width preferences.

Content comes before controls. Navigation has one dominant current location, with quieter duplicate shortcuts. Working surfaces rely on rows, readable type and modest borders; contextual menus and dialogs carry secondary controls. Documents can hold expressive content, covers and images without making the surrounding workspace decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Flat neutral surfaces with restrained blue action and focus.
Compact system sans chrome; expressive document preferences.
One dominant navigation selection and progressive controls.
Monochrome regular-weight Phosphor icons across page surfaces.
Immediate repeated interactions, visible keyboard focus and reduced motion.

rules.name: Content First
rules.body: Keep the working content visually dominant. Use compact titles and toolbars on data surfaces; reserve spacious reading geometry for documents.

rules.name: One Current Location
rules.body: Use the selected fill for the current main navigation or tree location. A duplicate favorite shortcut may use stronger text without another selected fill.

rules.name: Chrome Stays Native
rules.body: Use the system sans family for workspace controls. Apply serif and mono choices within documents rather than introducing a separate display face for chrome.

rules.name: Flat at Rest
rules.body: Use neutral tone and thin borders for working surfaces. Reserve the overlay shadow for menus, dialogs and the mobile sidebar.

rules.name: State Before Motion
rules.body: Make hover, press, selection and keyboard focus readable immediately. Honor reduced motion; do not turn the unused easing declaration into a transition requirement.

dos: Do use the source light/dark semantic variables for working surfaces, text, dividers and focus.
Do keep one dominant sidebar selection and use monochrome Phosphor page icons consistently.
Do share native property fields between table cells and row details, with readable date display and a native editor.
Do place block controls in the desktop editing gutter and use the mobile editing toolbar on narrow screens.
Do preserve document font, small-text, full-width, cover and image preferences.
Do retain visible focus, accessible labels, disabled states and the coarse-pointer field sizing.
donts: Don't introduce decorative dashboard cards or a display font into workspace chrome.
Don't expand every database view into the default toolbar; use the existing view picker.
Don't use emoji or typographic glyphs as new interface or page icons.
Don't use shadows to lift ordinary database cards or working rows.
Don't require hover to reach essential controls or add animated navigation.
